Check out our different paid offerings and see how we can enhance your recreation, fitness, wellness, and career! services.name: Locker Rental
services.desc: Any SRAC members can utilize a day use locker for their storage needs. No combination lock is required; combination locks are built into the locker. Fall Rental Lockers are available for purchase at the SRAC Front Desk. Fall Rental Lockers are valid from TBA. You will be provided a combination to unlock the locker; no combination lock is required. Only one occupant is allowed to use each locker. Patrons are not allowed to share lockers. Locker must be vacated by the time SRAC closes on the end date of the locker rental period. blurb: No matter how you get your “rec” on, you’re going to enjoy the new Spartan Recreation and Aquatic Center (SRAC). This state-of-the-art facility houses everything you need to begin or maintain your fitness goals. Sign up for a cycle class, try bouldering, join a pick-up game or just hang out by the pool. SRAC offers you a way to pursue a host of physical activities right on campus.
